sources.citation: Niama Niama, Japhet. 2025. The Evolution of Noun Prefixes in West-Coastal Bantu Languages of Gabon. Languages 10:144.
sources.note: Nothing on stress; Itsengi (B53) data drawn from Mouélé 1997 and Ntolo 2001; only remark is that PB low-toned noun prefixes were retained.

sources.citation: Niama Niama, Japhet. 2021. Approche historico-comparative des langues bantu du Gabon : vers de nouveaux embranchements phonologiques partagés entre les groupes B50-60-70. Thèse de doctorat, Université Lumière Lyon 2. 361 pp. (HAL tel-03660292)
sources.note: Section 1.1.4 'Itsengi (B53)', pp. 61-67, is a second-hand phonological sketch after Ntolo 2001 (with reference to Mouélé 1997): two level tonemes H and L, rising/falling contours analysed as combinations; nothing on word stress/accent for Itsengi. Pp. 271-272 offer only a group-level diachronic hypothesis that B50 languages keep the H/L contrast in stem position T1 but not T2, read as a possible emerging 'processus accentuel' (citing Philippson 1991, Dodo-Bounguendza 2010, Rékanga 2007) -- no placement rule.
